title: Advanced and Applied Linear Algebra
description: Advanced topics in linear algebra with applications to data analysis, algorithms, dynamics and differential equations, and more. (1) General vector spaces, linear transformations, spaces isomorphisms; (2) spectral theory - normal matrices and their spectral properties, Rayleigh quotient, Courant-Fischer Theorem, Jordan forms, eigenvalue perturbations; (3) least squares problem and the Gauss-Markov Theorem; (4) singular value decomposition, its approximation properties, matrix norms, PCA and CCA
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: APMA E3101 AND APMA E4007 ; After the approval of APMA E4007 , it could also serve as a pre-requisite to 4008.
raw_title_text: APMA E4008 Advanced and Applied Linear Algebra. 3.00 points .
